working_target.instruction: Aim around 3,400 kcal/day consistently. Close is enough; do not force an exact number and do not treat a high day as a new target.

capture: protein when known from a label or clear amount
calibration_window.primary_read: Use the 7-day intake average/pattern with body and training response; do not overreact to one day.

after_window.later_frequency: occasional audits once the pattern is stable
return_to_daily_when: weight or circumference trajectory becomes unclear or unexpectedly fast/flat
training performance or recovery changes meaningfully

review_inputs: 1 to 3 comparable morning weights per week
repeat circumference measurements with the same method
scope: Monitoring only. No run or strength prescription change and no new supplement dose.
